benefit: Red clover interseeded into corn at V4 to V6 establishes under the canopy without competing during pollination. Provides 40 to 80 lb N per acre for the following crop, plus weed suppression after corn harvest.

members.title: Frost-seed red clover at corn V4 to V6
members.body: Broadcast red clover at 8 to 12 lb per acre between corn rows at V4 to V6. Cultivate lightly to set seed. Cover establishes after final canopy close-in.
